description: This Java class implements a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing key dictionary entries in a SQL time series database, providing methods to retrieve or save key IDs, fetch keys by ID, and list all entries with pagination.

classes.name: JpaKeyDictionaryDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing key dictionary entries in a SQL time series database, providing methods for key ID retrieval, key lookup, and listing all entries.

methods.name: getOrSaveKeyId
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID for a given string key, inserting it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the string key associated with a given key ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns all key dictionary entries with pagination support.

methods.name: cacheAndReturn
methods.description: Caches the key ID for a given key and returns it.
